name: bizflow-monorepo
description: BizFlow offline-first POS, inventory, finance, and business management software with desktop app, live browser demos, and one-time licensing.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. The two apps pin incompatible majors (Tailwind 3 vs 4, React 18 vs 19, Vite vs Next) and each keeps its own lock file. A root `workspaces` field makes npm walk up from apps/Bizflow, treat the repo root as the project, and validate against the ROOT lock file - which registers apps/website but not apps/Bizflow. Every install then dies with "npm ci can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json are in sync. Missing: vite@8.3.0 from lock file", listing packages that are present in the app's own lock. That is what broke the macOS and Linux installer jobs. The scripts below use --prefix instead.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/Bizflow run web:setup && npm --prefix apps/Bizflow run prisma:generate
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/Bizflow run lint && npm --prefix apps/website run lint
